en: A sepia-toned photograph of a Romanesque church porch with three arched openings supported by slender columns. At the top of the porch is a gabled structure with a statue in a niche. On either side of the steps stand two sculpted stone lions facing outward. The facade behind shows striped masonry and a row of small arcades above. The overall style suggests an historic European cathedral entrance.
